lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: We join Ash Ketchum, along with his companions, Misty and Brock, on their journey to the Pokémon League.

lines.speaker: Misty
lines.text: I feel like we're lost...

lines.speaker: Misty
lines.text: ...like usual.

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.text: Hey, I'm not the one who lost the map.

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.text: Sure would be nice if we had some kind of *mobile* device that could tell us where we are.

lines.speaker: Pikachu
lines.text: Pii... BROCK: Sure would be nice if we had some kind of *mobile* device that could tell us where we are.

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Nope! Just this mobile device that tells us what Pokémon are!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Which is really more important!

lines.speaker: Pikachu
lines.text: Pika!

lines.speaker: Pikachu
lines.text: MISTY [off-screen]: Hey, look over there! Is that a man?

lines.speaker: Pikachu
lines.text: ASH [o-s]: Wow! He sure is tall...

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.text: Guys, that definitely doesn't look like a human.

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.text: I think that might be a Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Pikachu
lines.text: Pikachu!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Oh wow!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Time to use my trusty Pokédex!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: POKÉDEX: "Data not found."

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: ASH [o-s]: Huh?!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: MISTY [o-s]: And technology has failed us...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Excuse me! Children, over there!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: It can talk?!

lines.speaker: Misty
lines.text: Just like Meowth!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Are you here for the tournament?

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Because people keep showing up early to fight me, and honestly, it's really starting to get old.

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: I mean, I set a date. The least people could do is wait for it...

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: You guys, I'm gonna' battle it!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Oh, well, I guess that answers that question.

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Let's see...

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: I can't tell what type it is, so let's try...

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Squirtle, GO!

lines.speaker: Squirtle
lines.text: Squirtle!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Wait, so *you're* not going to fight me?

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Of course not! This is a Pokémon battle!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Pokémon vs. Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: OK, you're saying that word, but I don't know what--

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Squirtle, he's distracted! Use Water Gun!

lines.speaker: Squirtle
lines.text: Squirtle! Squirt!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Well, today has been rather muggy, so... thanks?

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Oh no! It didn't have any effect!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: So, do I just... I'm just going to attack back, is that OK?

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Squirtle, use Skull Ba--!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: PER. CELL [o-s]: Ha!

lines.speaker: Squirtle
lines.text: SQUIRT!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: That was *Solar Beam*!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Did you say Solar Flare? Because that's a totally~ dif--

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: No wonder water didn't work on him!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: He's a GRASS-type Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: All right, this seems a lot like that card game the boy with the leather pants played with me.

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Is this Duel Monsters? 'Cause it feels like Duel Monsters.

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Charizard, GO~!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Whoa, is that a friggin' dragon?!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: 'Cause I'm gonna be honest - THAT'S pretty metal!

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.text: Actually, it's neither a steel-type, NOR a dragon-type!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Charizard! Use Flamethrower!

lines.speaker: Charizard
lines.text: (Dragon roar (?))

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Well, now I'm dry so, good job.

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Managed to give me a steam bath.

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Fire wasn't effective either!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Man, nothing I do is fazing it!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: The name's Cell, by the way!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Could have at least ASKED before you started throwing critters at me.

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: You're pretty strong...

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: But Pikachu and I have fought more battles than I can count!

lines.speaker: Pikachu
lines.text: Pii! ASH: But Pikachu and I have fought more battles than I can count!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: But Pikachu and I have fought more battles than I can count!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Not a high number, I'm sure.

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: And if there's anyone that can beat you, it's him.

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Go, Pika--!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: JESSIE [through speakers]: Not so fast, twerps!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: JAMES [ts]: We're here, we're queer, get used to it!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: JESSIE [o-s]: Wrong time, wrong place, James...

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: JAMES [o-s]: Sorry, Jessie, sorry! Let's just... start the thing.

lines.speaker: Jessie
lines.text: Prepare for trouble!

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: And make it double!

lines.speaker: Jessie
lines.text: To protect the world from devastation!

lines.speaker: Jessie
lines.text: JAMES [ts]: To unite all peoples within our nation! PER. CELL: OK, *what the f**k* is this fever dream?!

lines.speaker: Jessie
lines.text: JESSIE [ts]: To denounce the evils of truth and love! ASH [o-s]: Those guys are here to steal my Pikachu!

lines.speaker: Jessie
lines.text: JAMES [ts]: To extend our reach to the stars above! PER. CELL: OK, so you *know* these guys.

lines.speaker: Jessie
lines.text: JAMES [ts]: To extend our reach to the stars above! ASH [o-s]: Yeah! They're--

lines.speaker: Jessie
lines.text: Jessie!

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: James~!

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: JESSIE [ts]: Team Rocket blas--!
The usual TR screams

lines.speaker: James
lines.text: {PING}

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Dicks out for THOSE guys, amirite?

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.text: ...Are they gonna be OK?

lines.speaker: Misty
lines.text: Do you honestly care?

lines.speaker: Brock
lines.text: ...No. I actually don't.

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Alright, then. Back to the Pokémon battle!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Pikachu! I choose--!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: OK, all right, real talk?

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: I'm not a Pokémon, OK?

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: I don't even know what they are, like, wha-- what IS a Pokémon?

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: It's a...

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: "Pocket Monster".

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Are they in your pocket?

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: No - they're on my belt. In Pokéballs.

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Then they're not pocket monsters!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: *They're*... belt monsters.

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: *BALL* monsters!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: No, no, no, they're *CAPSULE* monsters!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: And you *duel* with them!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: So, they're *GODDAMNED Duel* Monsters!

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Th-- then, you're not a Poké--?

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: No, I am not a goddamn Pokémon!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Now get out of here, before I murder you and your little yellow rat!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Also, the guy who keeps squinting at me and your ginger girlfriend!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Sh-sh-shoo, sh-sh-shoo.

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: C'mon, Pikachu. Let's go find us a Pokémon Center.

lines.speaker: Pikachu
lines.text: PIKA~!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Oh my God, this is the longest seven days I've ever waited in my life.

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: I should've scheduled it for a Wednesday.

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Kill everyone on Hump Day! Insult to injury, th--

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: ...*is that f**king Freeza*?!
DBZ intermission (post-commercial)

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: Hey guys, my name is Stefan, and I was your editor for this video,

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: I hope you enjoyed it!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: If you did, you may also enjoy the crossover video Team FourStar did with Pokémon Abridged, Ash vs. Cell!

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: And when you're done with that, maybe check out Episode 2 of my show, Fist Master.

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: It's an animated show that commenters have been saying is like Dragonball Z meets Rick and Morty.

lines.speaker: Per. Cell
lines.text: So, maybe check those things out if you want.
